title: Full test suite run exceeds the darwin ceiling of 22 s on an unmodified origin/main clone
goal: A full python3 _tools/tests.py run on the macOS host finishes within the darwin max_seconds of _tools/tests_ceiling.json (observed 2026-10-11: 100 passed in 22.28 s, reported as 23 s, on a clean clone of origin/main with no other test run; the ceiling check then exits 1).
